chapter.title: Act I: The Thaw
subtitle: Spring, Year One
Make the old Kettle farm livable and wake the town up in time for the Thaw Fair.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

quests.title: Till and Plant the 3x9 Patch
quests.subtitle: Wheat, carrots, potatoes.
description: Marnie: "Three beds: wheat, carrots, potatoes. Anything fancier and you'll be eating it alone in July."

Till the 3x9 patch behind the house — every tile is marked in path blocks — then plant the 9 carrots, 9 potatoes and 9 wheat seeds from Marnie's sack. Do the wheat last: hand in holding the nine seeds, which the book counts and never takes.
Marnie hands over the fence, the gate, the trough and three Hen Crates for the pen next to it.

tasks.title: All 27 marked tiles tilled and planted

rewards.title: Three Beds of Dirt
rewards.description: Next: fence the pen on the marked blocks and open the three Hen Crates inside it.

quests.title: Fence the Pen and Open the Three Hen Crates
quests.subtitle: Two hens and a rooster.
description: Marnie: "Two hens and a rooster. Don't name the rooster — you'll get attached, and he is horrible."

Put a fence section on each of the 23 stone footings marked out behind the house, hang the gate on the single grey slab in the middle of the side facing you, then right-click all three Hen Crates inside the finished pen. Any order is right.
A nesting box goes down with two eggs in it, a Megatorch goes up over the coop, and chicken feed makes a hen lay when you right-click her.

tasks.title: Three chickens standing inside the finished pen

quests.title: Take Three Eggs to Marnie
quests.subtitle: Pip is watching the box.
description: Pip: "Is that an egg? Aunt Marnie says I get a duck if I'm useful, so I am being extremely useful."

Collect 3 eggs from the nesting box behind your house — right-click a hen with chicken feed if you would rather not wait — and hand them in here. Marnie gets them either way; the book does the walking.
Pip puts a duckling on your boot, names it Biscuit, and opens his courier board. Marnie tips 16 carded wool onto the counter.

rewards.title: Residents 2/15
rewards.description: Next: Marnie's kitchen needs an oven, and the oven needs dry boards. (The man at the mill is still there when you want him.)

quests.title: Talk to Bram at the Broken Mill
quests.subtitle: Walk west to the mill. He will accept 'hold this'.
description: Bram: "I don't need help — I need somebody to hold things. Different word, same pair of hands."
Walk to the mill plot marked on your map, talk to Bram, and bring back the Millwright's Bolt he puts in your hand.
Bram opens his labelled crates: 12 iron ingots and 24 andesite — three times what eight alloys want, because the Millstone wants the rest.

rewards.title: Residents 3/15
rewards.description: Next: craft 8 Andesite Alloy out of what Bram gave you. Eight, not nine — the rest of the crate is the Millstone's.

quests.title: Craft 8 Andesite Alloy
quests.subtitle: One andesite, one iron nugget. Eight, not nine.
description: Bram: "One andesite, one iron nugget, pressed. Eight of them, not nine — if you're making nine you've misread something."

Craft 8 Andesite Alloy — one andesite and one iron nugget each, so eight andesite and one ingot's worth of nuggets — and hold them when you hand the quest in. The rest of Bram's crate is for the Millstone.
You get a pre-made Mechanical Press, 8 cogwheels, 8 shafts and 32 wheat — the whole bill for the Millstone and its first grind.

rewards.title: Eight Alloys, No More
rewards.description: Next: Millstone plus Hand Crank, and grind 16 Wheat Flour for Marnie.

quests.title: Take Bram's Wide Hammer Off the Bench
quests.subtitle: Three by three. One swing.
description: Bram: "Josie said this thing made a man lazy. Then she borrowed it for eleven days and gave it back with the handle worn smooth."

Take the Stone Hammer off the peg by Bram's bench. It breaks a three-by-three face in one swing — every block in the square goes the same as the one in the middle — so aim the middle of the square at the middle of the hole you want.
It is yours. Bram will not take it back and he will not discuss it further.

tasks.title: Stone Hammer off the peg and in your bag

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Middle of the square, middle of the hole. And do not swing it in my mill.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Bram's Wide Hammer
rewards.description: Next: the Millstone and Hand Crank, and 16 flour for Marnie. The peg by Bram's bench is empty now and stays empty.

quests.title: Read the Ground Behind the Cottage
quests.subtitle: Ore lives in beds, and the beds leave signs.
description: Bram: "You'll not find iron by hitting stone and hoping. Nobody has, here, since Josie's day."

Walk the grass behind the cottage and look for the small rust-brown rocks lying about: those are ore samples, and every one of them sits over a bed of iron thirty blocks down. Dig straight under the samples and bring back 8 iron clusters (hematite breaks into them). Bram's wide hammer takes it three blocks at a time.
Every metal in the valley works this way: coal, copper, tin, silver, gold. Samples on the surface, the bed beneath. Tobin will teach you to read them properly in the summer.

tasks.title: 8 iron clusters from the bed behind the cottage

rewards.title: Next: 8 andesite alloy
rewards.description: Next: craft 8 Andesite Alloy for Bram.

quests.title: Mill 16 Flour on a Hand-Cranked Millstone
quests.subtitle: Your arm first, then the river.
description: Bram: "Hand crank first. You should know exactly what the water is doing for you before it starts doing it."
Build a Millstone, put a Hand Crank on top of it, and grind Bram's 32 wheat down to 16 Wheat Flour for Marnie.
Encased Fan, 3 Andesite Alloy, casings and iron — the parts list for the Mechanical Saw in two quests' time.

rewards.title: Turn It By Hand
rewards.description: Next: two Water Wheels — and they need Seasoned Oak Boards out of Marnie's bread oven.

quests.title: Dry 32 Green Oak Planks in Any Furnace
quests.subtitle: Two minutes of heat, and they're boards.
description: Marnie: "Green planks want heat and time. Josie dried every board in this valley in a furnace and was insufferable about it."
Smelt the 32 Green Oak Planks in any furnace — about two minutes for the lot — and hold 32 Seasoned Oak Boards. Marnie's charcoal is in the barrel by the door.
Bram cannot build a Water Wheel until these dry, and the furnace is you. Also the inn's crockery, your chair by the oven, the kitchen kit.

rewards.title: Dry Boards, in April
rewards.description: Next: fit the Counter, Sink and Oven along the inn's back wall. Bram's wheels are unblocked.

quests.title: Build 2 Water Wheels on the Mill Race
quests.subtitle: The boards are dry; the race is cut.
description: Bram: "Race is cut, boards are dry, and I'm sixty-four. Two wheels, today."
Craft 2 Water Wheels using the Seasoned Oak Boards, set them in the mill race beside the mill, and belt the Millstone off them so it turns without you.
Mechanical Saw, Basin and Mixer, plus Bram's crate: 32 Andesite Alloy and 16 wool he has been keeping for windmill sails.

rewards.title: Water Finds a Way
rewards.description: Next: cut 128 boards on the Saw and give Bram 64 for Oda's market stalls.

quests.title: Cut 128 Boards and Give Bram 64
quests.subtitle: Sixty-four boards is four stalls.
description: Bram: "Oda wants four stalls for the fair. Sixty-four boards is four stalls."

Cut 128 Oak Planks on the Mechanical Saw — about twenty-two oak logs off the ridge behind the mill. Hold all 128 when you hand in: the book counts the full 128 and only takes 64 of them for Bram's stalls. You are not cutting 192.
Stage market_stalls: the Thaw Fair now has somewhere to trade from, and you keep Macaw's roof kits and four planters for your own roof.

tasks.title: 64 of them go to Bram for the stalls

rewards.title: Four Stalls for the Fair
rewards.description: Next: Oda's store. She wants 16 flour and 8 loaves, and the cobwebs gone.

quests.title: Fit the Kitchen and Cook Three Dishes
quests.subtitle: Counter, sink, oven. The pumpkin is wild.
description: Marnie: "Counter, sink, oven, along the back wall in that order. I've had the spots chalked for four years."

Hold the Counter, Sink and Oven at hand-in; the book gives them back. Set them on the inn's three grey slabs, 1, 2, 3: counter, sink, oven. Cook Bread, Pumpkin Pie and Vegetable Soup. The crate holds all but the pumpkin, which is wild.
You get the recipe book, the fruit basket, Marnie's cupboards — and Oda's broom off the back door, which Q19 needs.

rewards.title: Marnie's Kitchen
rewards.description: Next: sweep Oda's store with the broom, then bring her 16 flour and 8 loaves.

quests.title: Sweep Oda's Store, Bring 16 Flour and 8 Bread
quests.subtitle: Act I finale — The Thaw Fair.
description: Oda: "Eleven years of keeping the ledger of a shop with nothing in it. Bring me stock and I will open the door."
Sweep the marked cobwebs out of the store with Oda's broom, then hand her 16 Wheat Flour and 8 Bread across the counter.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.
The Thaw Fair opens at the Town Anchor: four stalls, a long table, six lamps burning, and five people in a field that froze in February.

tasks.title: Every marked cobweb swept out of the store

rewards.title: The Thaw Fair
rewards.description: Next: type Ribbit into Marnie's compass and follow the needle. Also a woman fixing a beached boat at the lake, and a prospector at the copper outcrop.
